description.value: Rong Rong Tea House is a Taiwanese restaurant serving dishes such as beef noodle soup and chicken steak in what OSM describes as an indoor-seating, smoke-free setting. The business appears to be located on Agnes Street, most likely in New Westminster based on residual website branding and coordinates, though the OSM community tag erroneously lists North Vancouver. The domain has been hijacked by gambling-spam content, so current operating status cannot be confirmed from the website.
